name: Sonic cleansing brush

lead: A sonic cleansing brush is a handheld device with a soft bristle head that oscillates at high frequency while cleansing the face. Clarisonic popularized the category, and many brands now sell similar tools.
It is used for deeper removal of makeup, oil and pollution than hands alone and for a smoother-feeling surface.

paras: The head vibrates thousands of times per minute, loosening debris and sebum from pores and the skin surface, which makes cleansers work more effectively than manual washing.

Overuse or rough settings can irritate or over-exfoliate skin, especially for sensitive or acne-prone skin, and bristle heads need replacing to avoid bacterial build-up. Evidence is modest: a clinician review and small studies show better particulate removal and acne improvement in uncontrolled cohorts, but few randomized trials. The effect is cleansing, not anti-aging.
